## Automated Tests Required

### Story 001 — BattleHUD Class Skeleton + 9-Param DI (Logic) ✅ SHIPPED
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/feature/battle_hud/battle_hud_skeleton_test.gd`
**Status**: Exists — 10 test functions, 852/852 PASS regression baseline preserved at S6-05 close.
**What to test** (already covered):
- `class_name BattleHUD extends Control` resolves; `is BattleHUD AND is Control AND NOT is CanvasLayer`
- `setup(...)` 9 typed params wire `_<backend>` private fields one-to-one
- `_ready()` asserts all 9 backends non-null (proxy pattern via pre-setup null-field assertion per TD-059 — direct assert-crash testing structurally impossible in GdUnit4 v6.1.2)
- `_ready()` calls `set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)` (anchor_left/top/right/bottom values verified)
- `_handle_signal(name, args)` empty-body seam invocable without error
- `_exit_tree()` empty-body invocable without error
- `scenes/battle/battle_hud.tscn` loads + instantiates as BattleHUD root
- AC-8 + AC-9 manual grep gates (non-emitter discipline + Pillar 2 token absence) — codified as story-008 Lints 1+2

**Edge cases** (already covered):
- `is CanvasLayer` returns FALSE
- setup() invoked twice — second call replaces references (no re-entry guard required)
- Pre-setup `_ready()` triggers assertion via proxy null-field check

**Test count**: 10 unit tests — DONE.

### Story 002 — 11 GameBus Signal Subscriptions + S5 Filter (Logic + Integration) ✅ SHIPPED
**Test files**:
- `tests/unit/feature/battle_hud/battle_hud_signals_test.gd` (10 tests)
- `tests/integration/feature/battle_hud/battle_hud_recursive_filter_test.gd` (3 tests)
- Helper — `tests/helpers/battle_hud_capture_subclass.gd`

**Status**: Exists — 13/13 PASS, 865/865 regression baseline (21st consecutive failure-free).

**What to test** (already covered):
- AC-1 — 11 connect calls all use `Object.CONNECT_DEFERRED` (parameterised 11 × 2 assertions via `Signal.get_connections()[i].flags`)
- AC-1 regression — `CONNECT_DEFFERED` typo grep guard (silent enum-typo trap)
- AC-2 — Pillar 2 lock: `_grid_controller.hidden_fate_condition_progressed.get_connections()` filters HUD-targeted callables to size 0
- AC-3 — 11 `_on_*` handlers each forward to `_handle_signal(name, args)` via capture-subclass DI seam (parameterised 11 sub-cases)
- AC-3 edge — same signal twice = 2 captures
- AC-4 — `_exit_tree()` disconnects all 11 (parameterised emitter check)
- AC-4 edge — re-add via `request_ready()` re-subscribes (note: Godot fires `_ready` once per Node lifetime; test uses `request_ready()` test-only mechanism)
- AC-5 — S5 INPUT_BLOCKED → `mouse_filter == MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE`; revert → STOP; non-S5 transition → unchanged
- AC-6 chain — `input_state_changed` signal-handler chain to `mouse_filter` property mutation (structural)

**Behavioral gate deferred to manual**:
AC-6 BEHAVIORAL recursive-disable (Button.pressed must NOT fire while root MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE) is dropped from automated suite — `Input.parse_input_event` and `Viewport.push_input` empirically bypass Control mouse_filter chain in GdUnit4 headless mode. **Cross-platform manual gate** per ADR-0015 Engine Verification Item 5; KEEP through Polish; TD-062 tracks formal evidence template.

**Test count**: 13 tests (10 unit + 3 integration) — DONE.

### Story 003 — UI-GB-03 Unit Info Panel + UI-GB-11 DEFEND Seal + show_unit_info() (UI + Integration)
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/feature/battle_hud/battle_hud_unit_info_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- AC-1 — UI-GB-03 element mounts at `_ready()` (child-of-hud + visible == false)
- AC-2 — UI-GB-11 DEFEND seal element mounts at `_ready()`
- AC-3 — `show_unit_info(unit_id)` populates UI-GB-03 from HPStatusController + HeroDatabase + UnitRole stubs (HP bar value/max, status icon for DEFEND_STANCE, `_active_status_panel_unit_id` updated)
- AC-4 — `show_unit_info(-1)` dismisses panel + clears `_active_status_panel_unit_id`
- AC-5 — `_grid_controller.unit_selected_changed.emit(42, true)` (CONNECT_DEFERRED → flush) routes through `show_unit_info(42)`; `(42, false)` after `(42, true)` dismisses
- AC-6 — `damage_applied(7, 42, 30)` refreshes HP bar when `defender_id == _active_status_panel_unit_id`; `damage_applied(7, 99, 30)` (different defender) leaves bar unchanged
- AC-7 — `unit_turn_started(42)` refreshes UI-GB-03 + expires UI-GB-11 DEFEND seal when status no longer present

**Edge cases to cover**:
- HeroDatabase.get_hero(unit_id) returns null → log warning + render localized placeholder (`tr(&"hud.unit_info.unknown_unit")`); panel still visible (graceful degradation per epic R-3)
- `unit_turn_started(99)` (different unit) → UI-GB-03/UI-GB-11 unchanged for unit 42
- `show_unit_info(-1)` when panel already hidden — no-op no error

**Manual gate**:
- AC-8 — AccessKit screen reader on macOS VoiceOver (Engine Verification Item 2) — focus UI-GB-03 root via Tab; assert audible announcement of unit name + HP + status. Document in `production/qa/evidence/battle-hud-story-003-evidence.md`.
- AC-9 — i18n grep gate: zero hardcoded literal strings in `src/feature/battle_hud/`. Story-008 Lint 5 automates.

**Estimated test count**: ~7 integration tests + AccessKit + i18n manual entries.

### Story 004 — UI-GB-01 Initiative Queue + UI-GB-07 Counter + UI-GB-08 Victory (UI + Integration)
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/feature/battle_hud/battle_hud_initiative_queue_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- AC-1 — UI-GB-01/07/08 mount at `_ready()`; UI-GB-01/07 visible at battle start; UI-GB-08 hidden until `set_victory_condition()` called
- AC-2 — `round_started.emit(3)` rebuilds UI-GB-01 from `_turn_runner.get_turn_order_snapshot()` (slots[0..N-1] populated, slots[N..7] hidden); UI-GB-07 round_label resolves `tr(&"hud.counter.round_format") % 3`
- AC-3 — `unit_turn_started(7)` highlights matching slot; `_active_queue_slot_index == 1`; turn_label includes hero name for unit 7
- AC-4 — `unit_turn_ended(7)` clears highlight; `_active_queue_slot_index == -1`
- AC-5 — `unit_died(7)` rebuilds UI-GB-01 from fresh snapshot (dead unit removed)
- AC-6 — `set_victory_condition(&"victory.scenario_01.defeat_commander")` shows UI-GB-08 with translated text

**Edge cases to cover**:
- snapshot.size() > 8 → first 8 only rendered
- snapshot.size() == 0 → all 8 slots hidden, UI-GB-07 round_label still updates
- `unit_turn_started(999)` with unit_id NOT in queue → no highlight, `_active_queue_slot_index == -1`, turn_label still updates with fallback hero name
- Dying unit was active (highlighted before) → highlight clears OR migrates to new active per turn_runner state
- `set_victory_condition()` called twice — second call replaces text

**Manual gate**:
- AC-7 — i18n grep gate (story-008 Lint 5 automates)
- AC-8 — UI-GB-01 portrait tooltip presence pre-flight (per-slot tooltip = `tr(&"hud.queue.upcoming") + " " + hero_data.name`)

**Estimated test count**: ~6 integration tests.

### Story 005 — UI-GB-02 Action Menu + UI-GB-05 Skill List + UI-GB-10 Undo + Two-Tap ATTACK/DEFEND (UI + Integration)
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/feature/battle_hud/battle_hud_two_tap_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- AC-1 — UI-GB-02/05/10 mount hidden at `_ready()`
- AC-2 — `unit_selected_changed(42, true)` shows UI-GB-02 for active player unit; all 6 action Buttons enabled per `is_action_available(42, *)` query; `(99, true)` (non-active unit) keeps UI-GB-02 hidden
- AC-3 — Two-tap ATTACK happy path: first tap arms (`_two_tap_target_action == &"attack"`, timer started, button shows pending visual); second tap within window invokes `_input_router._handle_event(InputEventAction(&"attack_confirm", true))` exactly once; clears state + stops timer
- AC-4 — Two-tap DEFEND mirrors ATTACK pattern; cross-action tap (ATTACK first, DEFEND second) cancels first arm + arms DEFEND
- AC-5 — Two-tap timer.timeout cancels pending action; ATTACK button visual reverts; NO `_input_router._handle_event(attack_confirm)` invoked
- AC-6 — `unit_moved(42, ...)` shows UI-GB-10 if `is_undo_available(42) == true`; click invokes `_input_router._handle_event(InputEventAction(&"undo_action"))`
- AC-7 — USE_SKILL reveals UI-GB-05; skill slot click invokes `skill_use_<slot>` synthetic event; cooldown disables slot

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Tap non-ATTACK/DEFEND action while ATTACK armed (e.g., MOVE) → ATTACK arm cancels, MOVE invokes its own synthetic event
- Skill on cooldown → slot Button disabled (modulate dim); click does NOT emit synthetic event
- `is_undo_available(42)` flips to false on next signal sweep → UI-GB-10 visible == false

**Manual gate**:
- AC-8 — 44pt touch target manual pre-flight on all UI-GB-02/05/10 .tscn files (story-008 Lint 4 automates)
- AC-9 — AC-UX-HUD-08 + AC-UX-HUD-09 mobile two-tap contract verification (HUD owns `_two_tap_timer`; synthetic event StringNames match `attack_confirm` / `defend_confirm`); document in `production/qa/evidence/battle-hud-story-005-evidence.md`

**GDD AC reference**:
- AC-UX-HUD-09 v1.1 mandates `TWO_TAP_TIMEOUT_S = 15.0s` window, no long-press gating, DEFEND-row pulse 0.15s ±20ms, surrounding rows desaturate to 0.5 alpha. Test fixture `tests/fixtures/battle_hud/defend_two_tap.yaml` referenced by GDD AC-UX-HUD-09 — verify fixture exists at story-author time OR scope a fixture-creation task.

**Estimated test count**: ~7 integration tests + 1 fixture file.

### Story 006 — UI-GB-04 Combat Forecast (UI + Performance)
**Test files**:
- `tests/unit/feature/battle_hud/balance_entities_battle_hud_test.gd` (BalanceConstants entry)
- `tests/integration/feature/battle_hud/battle_hud_forecast_test.gd` (rendering + dismiss)

**What to test**:
- AC-1 — `_ui_elements[&"UI-GB-04"]` non-null + hidden; `BalanceConstants.get_const(&"FORECAST_RENDER_BUDGET_MS") == 120` (int)
- AC-2 — `show_forecast(42, 99)` populates 6 sections (Direction, Hit/Crit, Damage range, Counter-attack, Status effects, Passives); render time `t = (Time.get_ticks_usec() - _forecast_show_us) / 1000.0` < 120 ms
- AC-3 — `damage_applied(42, 99, 30)` triggers `_dismiss_forecast(&"damage_applied")`; Tween-based fade; `dismiss_ms < 80.0` from start of dismiss to `Tween.finished`
- AC-4 — `round_started(4)` force-dismiss path runs Tween if forecast visible; no-op if invisible
- AC-5 — Section 6 passive precedence: Rally > Formation > TR; 3-line cap; 4th passive not rendered (or overflow indicator per §4.1)
- AC-9 — Performance gate: 100 iterations of `show_forecast` in headless mode; record avg + p50 + p99; **assert p99 < 120 ms** (FORECAST_RENDER_BUDGET_MS)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Parameterised over (counter / no counter), (Rally / no Rally), (Formation / no Formation), (TR chip / no TR chip), (3 passives / 4+ passives precedence cap)
- Forecast invisible at `damage_applied` time — dismiss is no-op (no error)
- Only Formation + TR active → 2 lines rendered

**Manual gate**:
- AC-6 — Chevron hit area ≥ 44×44pt (.tscn `custom_minimum_size` pre-flight; story-008 Lint 4 automates)
- AC-7 — Reserved-color audit per AC-UX-HUD-05: zero 주홍 (#C0392B and ΔE 5.0 neighbours) anywhere in UI-GB-04 variants; 황금 (#C9A84C) only with art-director sign-off
- AC-8 — Dual-focus simultaneity on macOS Metal + Linux Vulkan (Engine Verification Item 1): UI-GB-02 keyboard focus highlight remains visible while UI-GB-04 forecast renders from mouse hover; both feedback channels visible same frame

**GDD AC reference**:
- AC-UX-HUD-01 — render budget ≤ 120 ms via deterministic two-frame seam (Grid Battle AC-GB-24 co-owned)
- AC-UX-HUD-01 sub-assertion (v1.1) — render-abort on hover-dismiss race; cursor-exit injected synchronously after `attack_target_hovered` before first `await get_tree().process_frame`; assert `forecast_render_aborted == true`; no 1-frame flash
- AC-UX-HUD-03 — PC viewport ≥ 480pt: cursor-leave dismisses within 80 ms; hysteresis (UX-EC-03) tested independently with t=20ms bounce — must NOT dismiss

**Estimated test count**: ~9 tests (1 unit BalanceConstants + 8 integration covering rendering + dismiss + precedence + perf gate + render-abort race).

### Story 007 — UI-GB-06 Tile Tooltip + UI-GB-09 Results + UI-GB-12/13/14 Grid Overlays (UI + Integration + Performance)
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/feature/battle_hud/battle_hud_overlays_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- AC-1 — UI-GB-06/09 mount as HUD-root children (hidden); UI-GB-12/13/14 mount as GridLayer children via cross-tree NodePath; missing GridLayer parent at test fixture → `_grid_layer_overlays` empty + warning logged (graceful degradation)
- AC-2 — `show_tile_info(Vector2i(3,4))` populates UI-GB-06 from `_map_grid.get_tile(coord)` + `_terrain_effect.get_modifier(coord, ...)`; positions via `_camera.get_canvas_transform() * world_pos`
- AC-3 — `show_tile_info(Vector2i(-1,-1))` dismisses UI-GB-06
- AC-4 — `battle_outcome_resolved(VICTORY, fate_data)` renders UI-GB-09 with localized outcome label; **Pillar 2 audit assertion**: walk UI-GB-09 child tree + assert NO Label.text contains any per-condition fate counter value from test payload's `fate_data` dict
- AC-5 — UI-GB-09 results render performance gate: 100 iterations, p99 < 200 ms
- AC-6 — `formation_bonuses_updated(snapshot)` re-renders UI-GB-13 Rally aura at correct opacity per Commander adjacency tier (1 = 20%, 2 = 30%, 3+ = 40%); UI-GB-14 Formation aura on pattern role tiles
- AC-7 — `unit_selected_changed(42, true)` with Strategist unit + TR-extended tile set populates UI-GB-12; Commander selected → UI-GB-12 hidden (Commander has no TR per CR-14)
- AC-8 — Per-frame zoom-poll budget: 1000 `_process` calls in headless mode; avg ≤ 0.05 ms per call; if breached, raise ADR-0013 amendment for `camera_zoom_changed` signal

**Edge cases to cover**:
- `_map_grid.get_tile(coord)` returns null → log warning + render placeholder OR keep UI-GB-06 hidden
- `show_tile_info(Vector2i(-1,-1))` dismiss when already hidden — no-op
- Empty snapshot → all overlays hidden
- Commander dies → next snapshot lacks Commander → Rally overlay disappears on next render
- All UI-GB-12/13/14 hidden → `set_process(false)` for zero per-frame cost

**Manual gate**:
- AC-9 — Pillar 2 audit: zero references to `hidden_fate_condition_progressed` token; zero string-formatting of any `fate_data` per-condition keys; UI-GB-09 reads `outcome` field only (story-008 Lint 1 automates token-absence)
- AC-10 — UI-GB-13 dashed border (2px logical, 황금 80% opacity) visible regardless of fill opacity per pass-11c R-3 colorblind-accessibility; document in `production/qa/evidence/battle-hud-story-007-evidence.md`

**Estimated test count**: ~8 integration tests + 2 manual entries.

## Smoke Test Scope

Critical paths to verify before any QA hand-off for the Battle HUD epic:

1. **Game launches** to first BattleScene without crash (BattleHUD instantiation + 9-param DI + 11 signal subscriptions complete)
2. **All 14 UI-GB-* elements** mount in scene tree on battle init: UI-GB-01..11 under HUDLayer; UI-GB-12/13/14 under GridLayer (cross-tree NodePath resolved)
3. **Selecting a unit** shows UI-GB-02 Action Menu (active player unit) + UI-GB-03 Unit Info Panel (any unit)
4. **Hovering an attack target** renders UI-GB-04 Combat Forecast within 120 ms; mouse-off dismisses within 80 ms
5. **Two-tap ATTACK confirm flow** on touch device: first tap arms (button pulse), second tap within 15s confirms (synthetic event reaches InputRouter)
6. **End-of-battle `battle_outcome_resolved`** renders UI-GB-09 with localized outcome label only (NO fate counters surfaced — Pillar 2 lock)
7. **GdUnit4 regression baseline** ≥ 870-880 PASS / 0 errors / 0 failures / 0 orphans / Exit 0 (currently 865/865 post-S6-06 — adds ~10-15 from stories 003-007 + smoke from 008)
8. **All 6 CI lints PASS** on PR — no new violations introduced
9. **No frame spikes** on Pixel 7-class hardware (Adreno 610 / Mali-G57 reference): per-frame steady-state HUD update < 1.0 ms p99; forecast burst ≤ 120 ms p99
10. **AccessKit smoke**: focus UI-GB-03 via Tab on macOS with VoiceOver enabled — at least one audible announcement (full sweep is per-story manual gate)

*Smoke tests are verified by the developer via `/smoke-check`. Reference this list when running that skill at story-008 epic-terminal close. Currently smoke-check budget runs to 30s headless + ~5min manual UI walkthrough.*

## Definition of Done — Battle HUD Epic

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — via automated test result OR documented manual evidence (screenshot, video, or playtest notes with sign-off)
- [ ] Test file exists at the specified path for all Logic and Integration stories (paths listed above)
- [ ] Manual evidence document exists at `production/qa/evidence/battle-hud-story-NNN-evidence.md` for all UI/UX-bearing stories
- [ ] Smoke check passes (run `/smoke-check sprint` before QA hand-off at story-008 epic-terminal)
- [ ] No regressions introduced — full GdUnit4 run reports ≥ 870-880 PASS / 0 errors / 0 failures / 0 orphans
- [ ] Code reviewed (via `/code-review` or documented peer review)
- [ ] Story file updated to `Status: Complete` (via `/story-done`)

The **epic** is DONE when:
- [ ] All 8 stories Complete (DoD above)
- [ ] All 6 CI lints PASS on `main` HEAD (story-008 Lints 1-6 + BalanceConstants key lint)
- [ ] All 7 Engine Compatibility verification items closed (per ADR-0015 §Engine Compatibility table — verification summary doc captures status)
- [ ] **Pillar 2 lint runs forever** (Lint 1 — never disabled even if HUD source split across multiple files; lint script reads from project-wide `BATTLE_HUD_SOURCE_FILES` config or .gd file glob)
- [ ] `FORECAST_RENDER_BUDGET_MS = 120` shipped in `assets/data/balance/balance_entities.json`
- [ ] `scenes/battle/battle_hud.tscn` + 14 child element scenes (UI-GB-01..14) all shipped at correct scene-tree paths
- [ ] `production/qa/evidence/battle_hud_verification_summary.md` shipped
- [ ] `production/sprint-status.yaml` battle-hud epic entries all marked `done`
- [ ] `docs/architecture/architecture-traceability.md` battle-hud row updated from "Ready" → "Complete"
- [ ] TR registry backfilled with battle-hud TR-IDs via `/architecture-review` delta (separate prerequisite — currently TR-battle-hud-* IDs reference story files but registry table not yet authored)

## Notes & Caveats

1. **Stories 001 + 002 are already COMPLETE** as of 2026-05-03 (S6-05 + S6-06). Their test files already exist and the regression baseline is at 865/865. This QA plan documents them retroactively for completeness; no new test work for those stories is required.
2. **Story-002 AC-6 behavioral cross-platform gate (TD-062)** is the only manual evidence item from already-shipped stories. Per ADR-0015 §Engine Compatibility, KEEP through Polish — schedule the cross-platform video capture during sprint-7 mobile-build cycles or defer to Polish phase.
3. **InputRouter dependency** — the input-handling Foundation epic is "Ready" not "Complete" as of 2026-05-03. Stories 002 / 005 / 007 use stubs for InputRouter integration tests (`tests/helpers/input_router_stub.gd`). Story-002 already front-loaded the `InputRouter.InputState` enum per ADR-0005 §1 ratified surface; production InputRouter implementation must keep the enum verbatim. Story-006 + story-007 remain stub-dependent.
4. **GDD AC-UX-HUD-09 fixture** — the GDD references `tests/fixtures/battle_hud/defend_two_tap.yaml` for two-tap test parameters. Verify fixture exists at story-005 author time; if absent, scope a fixture-creation task within story-005.
5. **TR registry backfill** — battle-hud TR-IDs (TR-battle-hud-001..017) are referenced in story files but `docs/architecture/tr-registry.yaml` has not yet been backfilled with battle-hud entries. This is a DoD prerequisite for epic-complete; track via separate `/architecture-review` delta in fresh session.
6. **Lean-mode QA gate skipping** — for stories 003-007, the user has indicated Lean-mode preference at sprint-6 (`Phase 4b QL-TEST-COVERAGE: SKIPPED — Lean mode`). This QA plan still documents the gates so they can be re-engaged for stories deemed risky (e.g., story-006 forecast performance gate is NOT optional even in Lean mode — the perf budget is binding via TR-battle-hud-014).
7. **Pillar 2 lint is the highest-stakes gate in this epic**. Story-008 Lint 1 (`lint_battle_hud_hidden_fate_non_subscription.sh`) is THE first pillar-anchored lint pattern in the project — KEEP forever, never disable. If a future Battle HUD designer believes they need to surface fate progress, they MUST first revise ADR-0015 (Superseded-by) AND `design/gdd/destiny-branch.md` Section B AND `design/gdd/game-concept.md` Pillar 2 (three coordinated revisions intentionally hard).
